evidence.detail: The class exposes one static String->String transform containing a hardcoded SpawnPK item-name table; every recognized item appends multi-line lore/effect text to the original display string and unrecognized items are returned unchanged.

Surviving exact entries include Killer's dagger, Adventurer's whip, Blood key, seasonal boost scrolls, holy shard/shard of balance, summer totem and multiple event consumables, each with embedded @yel@/@gre@/@or1@ color tags and line breaks.

Client.a(int,String,boolean) invokes this transform directly in the item display/hover path when the boolean detail mode is active, using its result as the displayed item text before fallback to R72 ItemHoverDescriptionConfig.

When this helper yields no special replacement under the active settings, the same client path falls back to R72's config-driven item hover description lookup, fixing this class as the older hardcoded description appender rather than a generic text utility.

proposals.note: LegacyItemDescriptionAppender is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for the live hardcoded item-description fallback used by the client item display path. No surviving original source noun was found; confidence is 0.997.
